reports.title: Enbridge Reports Strong Third Quarter Results, Places Over $3 Billion of Gas Transmission Projects Into Service, and Reaffirms 2026 Financial Guidance

guidance.heading: FINANCIAL OUTLOOK
section: The Company reaffirms its 2026 financial guidance for adjusted EBITDA between $20.2 billion and $20.8 billion and DCF per share between $5.70 and $6.10.
The Company also reaffirms its medium-term outlook for adjusted EBITDA, DCF per share, and EPS average compound annual growth rate of approximately 5%.
